issue.body:
## Problem

A failed upload is retried forever.

## Fix

Cap upload attempts at 3 in total: try, retry twice, then throw `upload failed after 3 attempts`.

## Done when

- [ ] At most 3 attempts are made.
- [ ] A test with an always-failing request counts exactly 3 attempts.

pr.title: fix(sample-kit): cap upload attempts at three
pr.body: Bounds the upload retry loop and adds a test.
